name: Random bytes
description: Generate random bytes locally, like openssl rand, as hex, base64 or a raw file.

name: File checksum
description: Hash a file and compare it with an expected checksum.

name: Bcrypt
description: Hash a password with bcrypt and check a hash against a password.

name: ULID generator
description: Generate Universally Unique Lexicographically Sortable Identifiers.

name: Text encrypt
description: Encrypt and decrypt text with AES-GCM, and decrypt legacy ciphers only.

name: BIP39 mnemonic
description: Create or recover a BIP39 mnemonic and its seed.

name: HMAC generator
description: Compute an HMAC over text with a secret key.

name: RSA key generator
description: Generate an RSA key pair and export it as PEM.

name: Password strength
description: Estimate how guessable a password is, without sending it anywhere.

name: Password generator
description: Generate a random password or an EFF Diceware passphrase in this browser.

name: EC key generator
description: Generate an Ed25519 or ECDSA key pair on this device.

name: SSH key generator
description: Generate an SSH key and show its fingerprint.

name: X.509 decoder
description: Decode a PEM X.509 certificate and list its fields.

name: CSR tool
description: Decode a certificate signing request, or build one with WebCrypto.

name: JWT debugger
description: Decode, sign and verify a JWT, and flag the none algorithm.

name: File encrypt
description: Encrypt and decrypt a file with AES-GCM in chunks.

name: Diceware
description: Generate a Diceware passphrase from the EFF wordlist.

name: Shamir sharing
description: Split a secret into shares and recover it from enough of them.

name: TOTP
description: Generate and check a TOTP code from a Base32 secret.
